subject: BrightCart query — clarify availability gap and potential SLA credit
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna@brightcart.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@brightcart.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 13:12:00 +0000
Subject: BrightCart service gap — saw 503 spike, please confirm window and credit eligibility

Hi Soojin,

We observed a burst of 503s that impacted checkout traffic this afternoon. Our SRE shows elevated error rates starting ~2027-04-02T13:20:00Z and normalizing by ~2027-04-02T13:29:00Z. That 9-minute window correlates with ~12% failed checkout attempts across our EU and US clusters (US is our primary traffic).

Can you confirm Redwood's observed downtime window and whether this qualifies for SLA credit? We need a formal confirmation (time window + eligibility) to route internally for finance and to trigger our remediation playbook.

I attached our traces (brightcart-raw-traces-20270402.zip). Happy to set up a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Jenna
Senior Ops Engineer, BrightCart
jenna@brightcart.com
(attachment: brightcart-raw-traces-20270402.zip)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@brightcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 13:35:00 +0000
Subject: Re: BrightCart service gap — saw 503 spike, please confirm window and credit eligibility

Hi Jenna — thanks for the quick note and for sending traces. I've looped in Karthik (SRE) and Marissa (CS) to help validate the window and run a preliminary credit check.

Quick asks from our side so we can expedite:
- Can you confirm which API routes/endpoints were most affected (checkout API v2 or payment-auth)?
- Any high-level traffic percentages by region (you mentioned EU and US — is US the bulk?)
- Consent to pull and process your request bundle (we'll use it only for the RCA and credit calc). If you can send a signed evidence release, that speeds the process.

I'll come back with an initial observed window within ~2 hours after Karthik's analysis.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: evidence-request-checklist.txt)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: BrightCart service gap — saw 503 spike, please confirm window and credit eligibility

FYI — quick telemetry check on our side: we see an elevated 503/error-rate spike that lines up with 2027-04-02T13:20:10Z through 2027-04-02T13:29:05Z on the US ingress path for the checkout model shard. Error volume peaked for ~3 minutes in that interval. Root cause looks like an autoscaler eviction cascade in the serving pool during a short tight GC/oom transient on a host group.

Preliminary notes:
- Impact: degraded availability for checkout model (increased 503s).
- Observed window: 13:20:10Z — 13:29:05Z (9 minutes).
- Severity candidate: we should treat this as a legitimate SLA event unless the customer had local retries that masked larger impact (need their regional breakdown).

I'll generate a log bundle and token-level error trace and attach it to the Drive link. If CS wants to offer a provisional credit we can compute a pro-rata amount; I'll hand the raw minutes and request IDs to Billing.

Karthik
SRE, Redwood Inference

On Fri, Apr 2, 2027 at 13:12 Jenna Park <jenna@brightcart.com> wrote: ...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 16:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: BrightCart service gap — credit stance and next steps

Thanks for the analysis summary, Karthik. From a CS/finance exposure perspective, offer the customer a provisional pro-rata credit tied to the confirmed 9-minute window while we complete the postmortem. Proposed approach:
- Provisional credit: 10% of daily usage prorated to the 9-minute impact window (billing will provide exact figure).
- Deliverables: postmortem with root cause and mitigation plan within 72 hours of final log bundle receipt.
- Condition: credit finalized once logs confirm no client-side misconfiguration that materially contributed.

Soojin — please send this provisional stance to BrightCart and request the signed evidence release so we can pull full traces.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@brightcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: BrightCart service gap — clarify availability gap and potential SLA credit

Hi Jenna — thanks for the traces. We ran a preliminary analysis and can confirm an elevated 503/error-rate window on our side from 2027-04-02T13:20:10Z through 2027-04-02T13:29:05Z (approx. 9 minutes) affecting the checkout model on the US ingress path.

Provisional credit posture: per Marissa above, we can offer a provisional pro-rata credit (~10% of a daily bill prorated to the impact window). Final credit amount will be determined after we complete the postmortem and reconcile logs.

Next steps:
- Please confirm acceptance of a provisional credit and attach a signed evidence release (we've attached a sample release and a provisional credit calc sheet).
- Once we have the signed release we'll pull the raw log bundle, finalize the RCA, and publish a postmortem within 72 hours.
- We've opened internal ticket RED-INC-20270402-BC and attached a draft postmortem to: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/cs/brightcart/postmortem-draft-BC-20270402

Attachments: redwood-provisional-credit-calculation.xlsx (provisional numbers).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
